text:
jamie: Heads up: planning deploy for inference-optimizer v2 with an optional DB migration. Target prod window 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/422. Need sign-offs from infra, SRE, QA, product. Rollout will be feature-flag gated + canary (10% -> 100% over ~20m). DB migration is online and backward-compatible but has a manual stop/rollback path.

ravi: Ack. I'll be SRE on-call for the window. Will run preflight smoke and watch p95. @dave please confirm infra capacity for canary nodes.

dave: Infra ok. Reserved 4 extra instances in prod-us-west for canary. If memory spike >85% we abort. I am rollback owner for infra (kubectl rollback).

maria: QA: will run the smoke checklist. Tests: /health, sample prompt through API, embeddings sanity. If failures, tag @jamie and pause rollout.

sophia: Product ack. Feature flag name: ff.infer.optimizer.v2. If we need to revert, we'll flip it to false and route to fallback model. Confirmed.

jamie: Pre-deploy checklist (quick):
- [ ] PR merged
- [ ] Canary nodes ready
- [ ] DB migration rehearsed
- [ ] QA smoke green
- [ ] Prod alerting on
Assigning: merge=jamie, canary=dave, migration=jamie, qa=maria, rollback=ravi

maria: Smoke commands I'll run at T+5m after canary: 
```
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.prod/redwood/v1/health
curl -X POST https://api.prod/redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"what is 2+2"}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: build 7f3a2 pushed to registry, image tagged infer-optimizer:v2; canary pipeline triggered.

ravi: Monitoring dashboard: https://internal/redwood/dashboards/inference-latency. I'll watch p50/p95, error-rate and token drop. Abort criteria: p95 > 600ms for 5m or error-rate > 1%.

jamie: DB migration plan: online-add-column then backfill in background; safe to rollback because reads tolerate null. Backfill can be stopped with `pkill -f backfill_job` and we can drop the column later. I'll run migration if canary green.

dave: :thumbsup: infra will run canary deploy now. Starting at 1994000100.

maria: Smoke PASS at 1994000200. All checks green, sample outputs look correct. No increase in mem.

ravi: SRE: observed stable p95=180ms, errors 0.05%. Proceed to 50% at +10m. @jamie flip ff to 50%.

jamie: Flipped ff.infer.optimizer.v2 -> 50% at 1994000250. Noting rollout steps in runbook: /runbooks/deploy-infer-optimizer.

sophia: Product confirms quality spot-check ok on convo samples. :tada:

jamie: Proceeding to 100% in 10m unless objections. Final rollback plan: flip FF -> false, roll back deployment with `kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-api -n prod` (owner dave), SRE to coordinate.

dave: :white_check_mark: will execute rollback if asked.

maria: Final smoke at 1994000350: PASS. QA signed off.

ravi: Green light. Marking thread done. :shipit:
